title: PostureScore
description: Schema for device posture and vulnerability data produced by M4 (Vulnerability & Posture Integration) and consumed by M5 (ML Risk-Scoring) and M2 (Policy Enforcement). Version 1.0 – frozen for Phase 1.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent posture assessment.

patch_level.description: Fraction of required OS and application patches applied. 1.0 = fully patched.

vuln_count.description: Total count of known CVEs/vulnerabilities detected on the device.

critical_vuln_count.description: Count of CVSS score 9.0+ (Critical) vulnerabilities. Non-zero immediately escalates policy.

os_compliant.description: True if the device OS version meets the minimum compliance baseline.

antivirus_active.description: True if an approved AV/EDR solution is running and up to date.

posture_score.description: Composite device posture score. 1.0 = fully compliant; 0.0 = non-compliant.
